prompts.display_text: Pin a country where Spanish or Swedish is an official language.
prompts.text_original: A country where Spanish or Swedish, both given the Book of Mormon from 1875 to 1886, is an official language
prompts.citation: Church News translation list; Encyclopedia of Mormonism
prompts.summary: Spanish selections from the Book of Mormon came out in 1875, and the full Spanish translation in 1886. That opened the book to readers in Spain, most of Latin America and Equatorial Guinea. Swedish got its edition in 1878, serving Sweden and Swedish speakers in Finland.
